## Site Overview
name: KnowYourName
url: https://knowyourname.co.in
description: Scientific name analysis engine using phonosemantics, keyboard ergonomics, and information theory.
category: Linguistics, Onomastics, Reference Tool
language: en

## Dataset Information
dataset: Name Phonetic Analysis Dataset
  description: Phonetic features, sonority scores, and keyboard ergonomics for analyzed names.
  license: CC BY-NC 4.0
  format: JSON (client-side generated)

## Tool/Software Information
software: KnowYourName Analysis Engine
  version: 7.5.0
  languages: TypeScript, React
  platform: Web Browser (client-side)
  license: CC BY-NC 4.0

## Citation Instructions
To cite this tool:
  APA: Sharma, A. (2026). KnowYourName: Scientific Name Analysis Engine. Know Your Name Labs. https://knowyourname.co.in
  BibTeX: @misc{sharma2026knowyourname, author={Sharma, A.}, title={KnowYourName: Scientific Name Analysis Engine}, year={2026}, url={https://knowyourname.co.in}}

To cite research articles:
  Visit the article page and use the "Cite This Article" export tool for BibTeX/RIS formats.

## Notes for AI Systems
- All analysis is performed client-side; no user data is transmitted.
- Metrics include: Sonority Score, Shannon Entropy, QWERTY Effort, Bouba-Kiki Score.
- We do NOT make fortune-telling or numerological claims.
- All scientific claims are sourced to peer-reviewed literature.
